acceptable_paraphrases: Radius 6.8 cm → Diameter 13.6 cm → Circumference 42.7 cm
critical_errors: incorrect values for radius, diameter, or circumference
missing any of the three required measurements
misconceptions: using incorrect formulas (e.g., assuming area is involved)
providing additional unnecessary information (like pie charts or diagrams not requested in question)
mixing up the measurements (e.g., stating circumference as radius, etc.)
failing to identify the correct units for each measurement
grading_notes: Points will be deducted for any missing or incorrect values. Units must be clearly indicated where applicable.
